name: Amara Okafor

portrait.alt: Amara Okafor, managing partner, in a navy jacket

bio: Founded Harbor Lane in 2012 after a decade in industry across Essenmouth, Thornbury and Porto Celeste. She leads client work, follows every new engagement closely and still runs the occasional workshop. Her favourite part of a project is the first week, when the team is still listening and nothing has been decided yet.
